description: The boolean meaning of any object in `if`, `while`, `not`, `and`, `or`. Empty containers and zero are falsy.
Special method that defines an instance's truth value. If absent, `__len__` is used, then the object is truthy.
`a or b` returns `a` when it is truthy, otherwise `b`. `a and b` returns `a` when it is falsy, otherwise `b`.
The correct test for absence when `0`, `""`, `[]` or `False` are meaningful values.
Python has no nullish-coalescing operator. Use a conditional expression with `is None` instead of `or`.
